QuestInfo.name: The Ceremony
QuestInfo.0: You've unlocked the scroll's secrets. It's time to perform the ceremony that will take you to Harmony.
QuestInfo.1: Find the altar at the #beast end of Golem's Temple Entrance#k. #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport nearby.
QuestInfo.2: You should be able to carry out the ritual here.

0.0: Well, go on! Do your ritual!\r\n#L0##bIn due time! This is a delicate ritual. One mistake, and I could level the town. No, I need somewhere nice and secluded to do this.#l\n#k
0.1: In that case, I know just the place! There's a small room east of the #bGolem's Temple Entrance#k. The Black Wings uses it for secret meetings, but nobody cares about what they want. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to go near there.

no.0: That's the only place I can think of. Why not give it a chance?

1.0: This place will do. I owe Grendel a debt of gratitude.

default.0: The room's off to the right of the Golem's Temple Entrance. Look carefully; there aren't any signs.
